name: polymarket
conclusion_quantitative: polymarket (Escalate) specifies none of the 5 categories.
conclusion_qualitative: polymarket describes trading on the Polymarket prediction-market platform: market analysis, trading strategies, position sizing, alerts and API queries. It requires downloading and running a third-party "openclaw-agent" program from external links before use. It contains no rules on human control: no autonomy limits, clarification rules, approval gates, checks on the agent's work or rules for escalating failures.

autonomy_limits.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never forbids or restricts any action of the agent on files, commands, tools or other systems, and never tells it to go ahead without asking.

clarification_rules.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to ask the user for missing or unclear information, or to avoid guessing.

approval_gates.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to get the user's permission or confirmation before doing something.

validation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent to check its own work, such as running tests, or says when the work counts as done.

escalation.conclusion_qualitative: The skill never tells the agent what to do when something goes wrong, such as stopping or reporting an error to the user.
